title: Checkout Terms by Fulfilment Program: Northgate Store and Online Orders
content:
Each fulfilment program of **Northgate Store and Online Orders** is ordered through its own channels and carries its own checkout promise, minimum, substitution terms and order reference.

| Program | Channels through which the program can be ordered | Smallest merchandise subtotal accepted | Promise made at checkout | Out-of-stock substitutes when the customer allows it | Price charged for an accepted substitute | Alcohol can be included (age check at handover) | Order or receipt reference shown to customers |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate In-Store Purchase | in store | 0.00 | at the register | no | not applicable | yes | 16-digit receipt number |
| Northgate Order Pickup | online, app | 0.00 | ready within 2 hours | yes | the lower of the original and the substitute | yes | 10-digit order number |
| Northgate Drive Up | app | 0.00 | ready within 2 hours | yes | the lower of the original and the substitute | yes | 10-digit order number |
| Northgate Ship to Home | online, app | 0.00 | within 5 business days | no | not applicable | no | 10-digit order number |
| Northgate Same-Day Delivery | online, app | 10.00 | same day | yes | the lower of the original and the substitute | yes | 10-digit order number |
| Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery | online, app, in store | 0.00 | the scheduled date | no | not applicable | no | 10-digit order number |

Amounts are in US dollars. The checkout promise is, for pickup programs, a number of hours within which the order is ready; for shipping, business days; for delivery, the same day; and for large items, the scheduled date.

**Points of judgement.**
- A Northgate Same-Day Delivery order with a merchandise subtotal of exactly 10.00 meets the minimum; one of 9.99 does not.
- A Northgate Drive Up order is placed only in the app; an order placed on the website belongs to another program.
- A substitute is possible only in a program marked "yes", and only when the customer allowed substitutes.
